title: Inazuma Sales Specialist
description: Vahid, the owner of the Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe, is currently having a headache over sales...

dialogs.text: This business is so hard. All my merchandise is good and they're the real deal...
But why does no one here want to buy anything?
What is the matter?
Oh, it's you, Traveler. *sigh* Forget it. I still cannot sell any fertilizer...
Don't you have Alrani to help you?
She did help me out a little. But trouble is, neither of us knows how to promote these goods. We can only wait for the customers to show up...
And you know about the situation in Ritou. Nobody is buying anything.
So I visited the gentlemen at the merchant guild to ask for help, and they suggested that we do something called marketing.

Simply put, they want us to talk more about the fertilizer's effects and the theory behind it with customers. We should also do more data-driven promotion, and we should offer a "free trial" service...
But... I really don't understand such complex matters. And I'm not the one who created this fertilizer, so how can I possibly explain it?
Anyway, even if it's just reciting the instructions, I believe I'll still need to run around and do some promotion.
Alrani is already out there promoting our goods. I am going out later as well. Traveler, could you please help us out?
Leave it to me.
Excellent! We are counting on you, Traveler.
The place you are going to is called Konda Village. It's not far from here.
There is a gentleman named Konda Densuke who has shown some interest in our fertilizer. He also came to the store to chat with me a little earlier.
If you could promote some of our goods at his place and offer him a free trial, he might just buy some fertilizer.
Where did Alrani go?
She said that she needed to collect some materials and that she'll have to go quite far away.

Youngsters, we meet again. What would you like to know this time?
I'm not here to ask questions this time.
Oh, did Vahid send you?
I heard about a novel fertilizer shop in Ritou. That's why I went to meet Mr. Vahid to try out his fertilizer.
If it works and increases crop production, there might be hope for restoring Konda Village.
Heh, I guess it is still up to an old relic such as myself to restore the village. Those young lads from the village... Hmph! You can't count on them.
Alright, tell me then. How should I use this fertilizer?
Add water first, then add crushed leaves before mixing them up.
Such a complicated procedure for fertilizer... Alright, I've got it.
Add crushed leaves first, then mix them, and add water at the end.
Add crushed leaves, then add water, then mix them up.
I'm here to talk about how to use the fertilizer.

So, tell me how to use the fertilizer...
Oh yes, right, I haven't explained it to you yet. The fertilizer you are taking there must be used in a certain way.
Now, let me see... according to the manual, the order should be...
You must first add <color=#37FFFF>water</color> to the fertilizer, before adding some <color=#37FFFF>crushed leaves</color>. Finally, <color=#37FFFF>mix them well</color> and apply it to the field.
Don't get the order wrong, or it may cause problems, which will affect our customers' impression of us. Our future business is at stake...
I remember.
Then I'm counting on you. Once you deliver the Anahitian Blessing to the customer, his first payment will be yours to keep.
Could you repeat the process again?
You must first add <color=#37FFFF>water</color> to the fertilizer, before adding some <color=#37FFFF>crushed leaves</color>. Finally, <color=#37FFFF>mix them well</color> and apply it to the field.
I'm counting on you, Traveler... Let's all work hard. With any luck, business this month might be good!
